note: Reviewed 2026-10-29. Every function with verify_jwt = false in supabase/config.toml skips the gateway JWT check, so it must authenticate its caller itself. Each entry names the mechanism and a marker (a regular expression, case-insensitive) that must appear in the function's index.ts. tests/unit/edge-function-auth-review.test.ts fails when config.toml and this file disagree, so a new verify_jwt = false function needs a reviewed entry here. 'public-by-design' is a short, deliberate list; see the notes.

mechanisms.admin-jwt-or-service-key: Supabase Auth JWT of an active admin of the target tenant (SUPER_ADMIN exact match), or the service key, via _shared/auth.ts
mechanisms.shared-secret-or-service-key: Constant-time shared secret header, or the service key. Fails closed when the secret is unset
mechanisms.provider-signature: Provider webhook signature verified before any work
mechanisms.capability-token: Unguessable per-record token supplied by the caller and matched against the database
mechanisms.customer-session-or-otp: Signed customer_session, OTP, or a confirmed-email Supabase Auth user
mechanisms.api-key-hmac: Hashed per-tenant API key plus request HMAC
mechanisms.mixed: Several caller classes, each authenticated in authorizeCaller
mechanisms.disabled: Endpoint returns 'unavailable' and does no work
mechanisms.public-by-design: Reachable without credentials on purpose; see the note on the entry

create-checkout.note: New checkouts are tenant-scoped and public; operating on an existing booking needs its waiver token or an operator/service caller

marketing-track.note: Open/click tracking must work from an email client. KNOWN ISSUE: the click redirect accepts any https URL (open redirect); needs HMAC-signed links

send-email.note: Also verifies the Supabase Auth email-hook signature (SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET)

web-chat.note: Anonymous visitors chat with the tenant's bot; tenant comes from the request, account actions need a customer_session
